summary: Describes a mechanism built on TLS or DTLS that lets a peer prove ownership of an identity, such as an X.509 certificate. The proof can be exported by one peer, sent out of band, and checked by the other peer. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: You show a badge on an existing phone call and later hand over a signed note to prove it was you. The other person can check the note belongs to that same conversation.

questions: how to prove identity after a tls handshake
